COMPUTER STUDIES OCTOBER — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: COMPUTER STUDIES OCTOBER
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Object Oriented Programming Implementation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Object Oriented Programming Implementation.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Object Oriented Programming Implementation.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Object Oriented Programming Implementation.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Object Oriented Programming Implementation.

2. When learning Binary Arithmetic Operations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Binary Arithmetic Operations.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Binary Arithmetic Operations.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Binary Arithmetic Operations.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Binary Arithmetic Operations.

3. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Remove all guards

4. When learning Web Development Fundamentals, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Web Development Fundamentals.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Web Development Fundamentals.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Web Development Fundamentals.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Web Development Fundamentals.

5. When learning Network Security, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Network Security.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Network Security.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Network Security.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Network Security.

6. When learning Structured Query Language, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Structured Query Language.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Structured Query Language.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Structured Query Language.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Structured Query Language.

7. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Ignore burnt cables

8. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Keyboard
   C. Speaker
   D. Monitor

9. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. International Cricket Team

10. When learning Object Oriented Programming Concepts, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Object Oriented Programming Concepts.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Object Oriented Programming Concepts.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Object Oriented Programming Concepts.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Object Oriented Programming Concepts.

11. When learning Logic Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Logic Circuits.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Logic Circuits.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Logic Circuits.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Logic Circuits.

12. When learning Computer Network Standards and Protocols, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Network Standards and Protocols.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Network Standards and Protocols.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Network Standards and Protocols.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Computer Network Standards and Protocols.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Relational Database Fundamentals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Structured Query Language and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Web Development Fundamentals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Data Representation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

5. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Network Security.

6. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Structured Query Language.

7. A — Never touch live wires with wet hands

8. A — CPU

9. B — Information and Communication Technology

11. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Logic Circuits.

12. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Network Standards and Protocols.
